purpose: Test the causal chain from the 2018 Sun Park disruption into the Guernsey Foundation/operating platform without treating temporal sequence as proof of actor-specific causation.
controlling_chain: Sun Park access/control and operating disruption → bookings/resident/customer receipts and contractual performance → GoCardless / Guernsey platform cash → payment of operating/professional/statutory costs → corporate good standing / Foundation administration → continuation of sales, distribution, acquisitions and claims.

evidence_events.event: Principal alleged Sun Park material-control pivot
evidence_events.causal_role: Starting event to be tested, not automatic cause of every later Guernsey consequence.

evidence_events.event: GoCardless receipts cease according to Jupiter's October 2018 email
evidence_events.causal_question: Which resident/customer payments ceased, what contracts/bookings generated them, and was cessation caused by loss of Sun Park control/operation?

evidence_events.event: Sun Rock Limited unable to continue paying Jupiter/Hamlins; strike-off/wind-up threatened
evidence_events.causal_question: Reconcile bank statements, GoCardless data, invoices and hotel cash flows.

evidence_events.event: Foundation, Sun Rock Limited and 499 still described by Jupiter as active; records/nominee trust structure identified
evidence_events.causal_question: Establish exact handover failure, funding requirement, service-provider replacement attempts and mitigation.

evidence_events.event: Guernsey Registry confirms Sun Rock Limited compulsorily struck off
evidence_events.causal_question: Obtain court/registry file to fix statutory cause, effective date and restoration consequences.

evidence_events.event: Professional KYC/law-firm records repeatedly identify Foundation/Sun Rock Group as affected and pursue restoration/claim structures
evidence_events.causal_question: Separate preservation/mitigation attempts from proof of underlying liability.

damage_hypotheses: Direct loss to Sun Rock Limited of sales/marketing income, receivables, contracts, IP/goodwill and acquisition/distribution opportunities if legally owned and causally affected.
Direct loss to The Sun Rock Foundation through diminution/loss of Foundation-owned company interests or other Foundation assets if proved.
Restoration, fiduciary, legal and compliance costs that were reasonably incurred or became necessary because of the disruption, subject to remoteness/mitigation.
Loss of the Solos acquisition opportunity and related distribution capability through Sun Rock Limited, subject to transaction-condition and counterfactual proof.
Reputational and platform loss only where a recognised cause of action and reliable valuation method exist.
mandatory_controls: Temporal proximity is not proof that the 7 June 2018 event caused every later corporate failure.
Jupiter's statement that receipts stopped is evidence of the cash shock; booking/payment records are required to identify source and cause.
Strike-off/winding-up consequences may also involve unpaid fees, service-provider transition, statutory filing decisions and mitigation choices; these are competing/interactive causes to be analysed.
Do not attribute Jupiter's or advisers' acts to Spanish actors absent proof of instruction, foreseeability or causal necessity.
Do not double count company value, lost income, receivables, IP, Solos opportunity and beneficiary/shareholder diminution.
priority_proof: Sun Rock Limited bank statements / general ledger
Jupiter invoices and statutory fee schedules
Appleby/Dixcart transfer correspondence and uncompleted handover documents
Guernsey Registry/court strike-off and restoration file
Foundation Charter/Rules and Sun Rock Limited/499 Declarations of Trust
Solos SPA/exclusivity and transaction payment/escrow records
